briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral/low-conviction session. With cash at $389.29 — below the $500 deployment threshold — and no new high-conviction, multi-signal setups warranting an exception, we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping the remaining slots open rather than forcing a buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on hand rather than investing it immediately, so you have flexibility to act when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was below our deployment threshold and the market showed no clear risk-on signal, so holding cash in reserve was the disciplined choice rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留現金而非立即全數投入市場，這樣在真正出現強勁機會時才有資金可以把握。今日現金餘額低於部署門檻，且市場也沒有明確的風險偏好訊號，因此保留現金觀望是較為紀律的做法，而非勉強進場交易。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 slightly. There's no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reads as consolidation after recent gains rather than a shift in sentiment. Days like this typically reward patience over action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，那斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，屬於方向不明的整理格局。市場並無明顯的單一催化因素，較像是近期漲勢後的短暫消化，而非情緒面的轉向。這類交易日通常較適合觀望而非貿然進場。
